title: Management Buyout Proposals and Inside Information

rival_explanations: control transfer hypothesis (stock price increases stem solely from expectations of a value-increasing control transfer, not inside information)
information hypothesis (price increases reflect favorable inside information revealed by the proposal, not control-transfer expectations)

mechanism.hypothesis: information asymmetry and probability of withdrawal

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (publicly traded firms with withdrawn management buyout proposals; exchange-listed and over-the-counter)
context.sample_size: 114 withdrawn buyout proposals (of 118 identified); comparison sample of 178 completed buyouts

data_sources.name: Mergers and Acquisitions "Out the Window" column

analyses.label: Market-model abnormal returns (risk-adjusted prediction errors) around proposal and withdrawal announcements
analyses.sample: 114 withdrawn management buyout proposals, November 1973-December 1989 (of 118 identified; CRSP data available for 114)

dv.name: cumulative abnormal stock returns (market-model prediction errors)

key_ivs.name: withdrawn management buyout proposal and withdrawal announcement (event)
key_ivs.measure: event dates: proposal announcement date (AD) and withdrawal announcement date (WD); abnormal returns cumulated over pre-proposal, interim, and post-withdrawal prediction intervals surrounding these dates

analyses.label: Abnormal stock returns using size-matched indices (Dimson-Marsh comparison portfolio approach)

key_ivs.name: withdrawn management buyout proposal and withdrawal announcement (event)
key_ivs.measure: event dates: proposal announcement date (AD) and withdrawal announcement date (WD); abnormal returns cumulated over intervals surrounding these dates
key_ivs.source: Dow Jones News/Retrieval service; Wall Street Journal Index listings; W. T. Grimm's Mergerstat Review

analyses.label: Abnormal returns partitioned by whether the firm received other acquisition bids
analyses.sample: subsamples: firms that received other acquisition bids vs. firms that received no other acquisition bids

dv.name: cumulative abnormal stock returns over proposal and withdrawal announcement periods

key_ivs.name: receipt of other acquisition bid(s)
key_ivs.source: Dow Jones News/Retrieval service; The Wall Street Journal

analyses.label: Comparison of asymmetric information proxies (withdrawn vs. completed buyout samples)
analyses.sample: withdrawn-proposal firms vs. completed-buyout firms (parametric difference of means test and Mann-Whitney U-test)

key_ivs.name: buyout proposal outcome (withdrawn vs. completed)
key_ivs.measure: sample partition: firms with withdrawn buyout proposals vs. firms with completed buyouts
